title: HR Executive
must_have: 1+ years of experience in human resources
text:
HR Executive
Periyar Infotech | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a hr executive to join our human resources team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- HRIS
- Stakeholder Management
- Performance Management
- Compensation Benchmarking
- Employee Engagement
- 1+ years of experience in human resources

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- HR Analytics
- Onboarding
- Workday
- Labour Law Compliance

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive campus recruitment drive with measurable outcomes.
- Drive annual appraisal cycle with measurable outcomes.
- Drive attrition review with measurable outcomes.
